migration_model: Codex and Claude SIRE skill trees consolidate into workflow/shared/sire; the general workflow governor remains workflow/support/ai-workflow-governor.
provenance_note: Each entry maps a preserved or active source copy to an existing canonical repository target. source_sha256 verifies that source copy; canonical_sha256 verifies the current repository target. A differing previously recorded digest is retained as recorded_source_sha256.
source_copy_scope: source_copy values are local provenance references outside this repository; they resolve only on the machine where the retained source copies exist.

archive_inventory.scope: Git-eligible files under sire/, excluding this manifest; obtained with git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard. Git-ignored external integrity/secrets/exports, caches and SQLite sidecars are excluded.
